title: Re-plug the iPhone's USB cable
instructions: The Mac sees no iPhone on USB (the cable is out, or it lost contact). Plug the cable into the iPhone (if it looks plugged in: unplug it, wait 3 s, plug it back in), unlock the phone, then press Done. This step closes by itself when the link is back.

history.note: the USB link is back (usblink.mjs: ok)
